tags.description: Bald Mountain – Designed in 1968, by W.B. Lewis, the Bald Mountain course has stood the test of time. Playing under the shadow of Bald Mountain itself, you can enjoy our beautiful views and first class conditions.
tags.name: Bald Mountain Golf Course

tags.description: Apple Valley Golf Course – Apple Valley opened in 1986 with rave reviews. It was called the “most beautiful mountain golf course” by Golf Digest. It was designed by Dan Maples, son of the great Ellis Maples.
tags.name: Apple Valley Golf Course
